survey_years.long_name: NIS-Teen survey year or pooled year range
survey_years.short_description: Survey year of the estimate, or the pooled range 2018-2022.
survey_years.long_description: NIS-Teen survey year of the estimate. The demographic files hold pooled 2018-2022 estimates, which are dated 2022-12-31 in the time column.

vaccine.short_description: Vaccine the estimate refers to: HPV, Tdap, MenACWY, MMR, HepB, HepA, or Varicella.
vaccine.long_description: Vaccine the estimate refers to. Tdap is the tetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis booster and MenACWY is the meningococcal conjugate vaccine. The Td or Tdap dose also counts Td.

dose.short_description: Dose count or series definition the coverage estimate uses, as published by CDC.
dose.long_description: Dose count or series definition the coverage estimate uses, as published by CDC. HPV 'Up-to-Date' means the two- or three-dose series completed per the ACIP schedule. Varicella doses are qualified by disease history because a history of chickenpox counts as immunity. For HPV the sex of the group is in the sex column, not the dose label.

insurance.short_description: Insurance coverage of the adolescent: Uninsured, Medicaid, Private, Other, or Overall.
insurance.long_description: Insurance coverage of the adolescent as reported by the parent: Uninsured, Medicaid (any Medicaid coverage), Private (private insurance only), Other, or Overall (all adolescents, reference).

poverty.short_description: Household poverty status: Below Poverty, At or Above Poverty, or Overall.
poverty.long_description: Household income relative to the federal poverty level for the household size: Below Poverty, At or Above Poverty, or Overall (all adolescents, reference).

urban.short_description: Type of residence: Rural, Smaller City, Larger City, or Overall.
urban.long_description: Residence of the adolescent by metropolitan statistical area (MSA) status, using the same labels as the NIS-Child file: Rural (living in a non-MSA), Smaller City (MSA, non-principal city), Larger City (MSA principal city), or Overall (all adolescents, reference).

nis_teen_coverage.short_description: Percent of adolescents who received the vaccine dose or series.
nis_teen_coverage.long_description: Survey estimate of the percent of adolescents ages 13-17, or 13-15 where the age column says so, who received the vaccine dose or series, from provider-verified records in the National Immunization Survey-Teen. CDC suppresses estimates with fewer than 30 respondents or a confidence interval half-width above 10 points.
nis_teen_coverage.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents had received the vaccine

nis_teen_coverage_lcl.long_name: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage
nis_teen_coverage_lcl.short_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.
nis_teen_coverage_lcl.long_description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.

nis_teen_coverage_ucl.long_name: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage
nis_teen_coverage_ucl.short_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.
nis_teen_coverage_ucl.long_description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for vaccination coverage.

nis_teen_sample_size.long_name: Unweighted number of adolescents with provider-verified records
nis_teen_sample_size.short_description: Number of surveyed adolescents with adequate provider data contributing to the estimate.
nis_teen_sample_size.long_description: Unweighted number of adolescents in the survey year and geography with adequate provider-reported vaccination data, the denominator for the coverage estimate.

nis.name: National Immunization Survey-Teen (NIS-Teen)
nis.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nis.location: Vaccination Coverage among Adolescents (13-17 Years), TeenVaxView
nis.description: The National Immunization Surveys (NIS) are a group of telephone surveys sponsored and conducted by CDC's National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases to monitor vaccination coverage. Cell phone numbers are randomly selected and called to enroll age-eligible children, and with parental permission vaccination providers are contacted to verify immunization records. NIS-Teen covers adolescents ages 13-17 and reports coverage for HPV, Tdap, MenACWY, MMR, hepatitis A and B, and varicella vaccines by survey year for states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U.S. Virgin Islands, and pooled 2018-2022 estimates by insurance, poverty, race and ethnicity, and urbanicity. HHS regions and sub-state local areas published by CDC are not included.
nis.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.summary: The National Immunization Survey-Teen (NIS-Teen) estimates how many adolescents ages 13-17 have received HPV, Tdap, meningococcal, and other recommended vaccines, by state and year.
